svg.text: Stage 7 — a second door (2026-11-02)
The operator panel lives behind its own listener, its own password and its own cookie. Spec 31, ADR 022.
FAMILY LISTENER :3000
The app, as before
Every app route lives here
No admin route exists on this port at all
/admin answers 404 — not 403, not a login page
An attacker who finds this origin finds no admin surface
Same process · same Prisma client · same scanner
“a different door, not a different house”
ADMIN LISTENER :3100
The operator panel
Separate ADMIN_PANEL_PASSWORD, seeded at boot
Separate session table, HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie
Read-only dashboard · library controls · SQL console
DB explorer: allowlisted tables, read-only driver
Published loopback-only on the host by default
Not reachable from the household LAN unless deliberate
The hosted demo gets a narrower version
One public port on Render, so a loopback-only proxy on that port forwards /admin and /api/admin/* to the loopback listener. The proxy forwards; it does not
authorize — the admin listener still checks its own cookie. Household deployments get 404. (Gated to the demo in spec 37, ADR 029.)
Drawn from 82191ff..2bd0e2e (spec 31) · ADR 022 · 19a0106 (proxy gated to the demo, spec 37 step 7.9, ADR 029)
